scientific_integrity: A self-contained proof gives an exact weak-null variational identity, radial tameness rigidity, and sharp mixed-exponent constants. Finite checker tests are supplementary, not proofs.
scientific_limitations: Only normalized real radial finite-dimensional extensions of infinite \(\ell_p\) with \(1<p<\infty\). First full characterization of tame Banach spaces is not claimed; independent scientific/bibliographic checks not performed.
title: Sharp tame-defect laws and rigidity for radial \(\ell_p\) extensions
